title: Audit log of user actions

requirements.text: Security-relevant and data-changing actions record actor, tenant, action, target, time, outcome and request id
The audit entry is written in the same transaction as the change it describes
Entries cannot be updated or deleted through the application, and tampering is detectable
Only authorized administrators of a tenant can read that tenant's entries
Secrets and sensitive personal data are redacted from recorded details
Entries can be filtered by actor, action and time range with pagination and exported
A declared retention period is enforced

notes: No Genlib audit log. Building blocks: structured-logger (key redaction, request ids) and the pii-mask capability, but a log stream is not a tenant-readable, append-only audit store.
